title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25G (Procedure for retrenchment)

content.overview: Section 25G requires retrenchment of a workman in a category to follow last-come-first-go, unless the employer records reasons for departing from it.
content.glance: Section 25G requires retrenchment of a workman in a category to follow last-come-first-go, unless the employer records reasons for departing from it.
content.study: Where a workman in a particular category is to be retrenched and he belongs to a class of workmen, the employer shall ordinarily retrench the workman who was the last person to be employed in that category, unless reasons for departing from that order are recorded.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 25G requires retrenchment of a workman in a category to follow last-come-first-go, unless the employer records reasons for departing from it.
